body:
Ahoy, young friend!

Your letter found me far out at sea, and I read it under the stars. What good questions you ask!

My ship is coming into harbour today. Come down to the coast and I'll answer them all. And bring strong arms: there's cargo to unload!
summary: Help Captain Mara unload her ship.

tasks.where: at the coop by your house
from the jug in your kitchen
